hints.title: The Forward Trap vs Reverse Insight
hints.text: If you pick which balloon to burst FIRST in range [i, j], the remaining balloons on the left and right now become adjacent to each other! Their future coins depend on what happens on the other side. This destroys subproblem independence! What if we invert time and pick which balloon is burst LAST?

hints.title: The Independence Invariant
hints.text: If balloon k is burst LAST in range (i, j), then during the entire process of bursting other balloons in (i, k) and (k, j), balloon k, balloon i, and balloon j remain unburst! That means the subproblems (i, k) and (k, j) are completely independent!

hints.title: Recurrence Relation
hints.text: Pad array with 1 at both ends: nums = [1] + nums + [1]. dp[i][j] = max coins from bursting all balloons strictly BETWEEN i and j. dp[i][j] = max_{k=i+1}^{j-1} (dp[i][k] + dp[k][j] + nums[i] * nums[k] * nums[j]).

hints.title: Complete Implementation
